title: 1.2 He and She
goal: Replace familiar singular people with he or she and describe four clear actions.

cards.prompt: The boy is eating, ___ is eating.
cards.answer_audio_text: The boy is eating, he is eating.

audio_assets.text: The boy is eating, he is eating.
The boy is eating, he is eating.

cards.prompt: The woman is drinking, ___ is drinking.
cards.answer_audio_text: The woman is drinking, she is drinking.

audio_assets.text: The woman is drinking, she is drinking.
The woman is drinking, she is drinking.

cards.prompt: The man is reading, ___ is reading.
cards.answer_audio_text: The man is reading, he is reading.

audio_assets.text: The man is reading, he is reading.
The man is reading, he is reading.

cards.prompt: The girl is sitting and ___ is writing.
cards.answer_audio_text: The girl is sitting and she is writing.

audio_assets.text: The girl is writing, she is writing.
